package.name: list-hygiene-judge
package.evidence_pin_note: verification.json and report.md are byte-identical at this pin and at HEAD. evidence.json cannot embed the hash of the commit that contains it; the pinned URL submitted with the delivery is authoritative.

toolchain.note: publish, install, dogfood and verify were all run with this binary.

publish.method: runx login --provider github --for publish --from-gh, then runx registry publish

cases.sealed_decay_re_permission: sealed - recency_days 400 over a 180-day decay threshold, no unsubscribe marker, hard_bounces 0 -> decision.state re_permission and one append_event on the contact stream.
cases.sealed_hard_bounce_suppress: sealed - hard_bounces 2 -> decision.state suppress and one append_event on the contact stream.
cases.stop_missing_or_stale_evidence: refused - engagement_history absent, so the evidence gate stops before deciding; both the append and the read-back are blocked by the graph guards and no event is emitted.

harness.repeatability: green on repeat runs against a warm store: a stream exactly one event ahead whose newest event is this judgment's own transition is treated as an idempotent replay, not as staleness.

dogfood.command: runx skill charlie-morrison/list-hygiene-judge@sha-db5cd96bfb28 --registry https://api.runx.ai --json -i data_source_ref=local://charlie-morrison-list-hygiene/dogfood -i store_id=list-hygiene-judge-dogfood-v1 -i resource=contacts -i aggregate_id=contact:dogfood:c-9002 -i expected_version=0 -i idempotency_key=contact:dogfood:c-9002:hygiene:v1 --input-json engagement_history='{"opens_count":0,"clicks_count":0,"hard_bounces":3,"recency_days":45}' --input-json bounce_policy='{"hard_bounce_action":"suppress","decay_threshold_days":180}' -i current_consent_state=subscribed
dogfood.note: This receipt_ref is the post-publish dogfood run of the published package, not a harness fixture seal.

observations.consent_state_reason: hard_bounces=3 read from contacts/contact:dogfood:c-9002; bounce_policy.hard_bounce_action=suppress so the contact transitions to suppress. send-as reads this recorded state at send time and will gate delivery.
observations.downstream_enforcer: send-as (separate governed run, dispatched by naming; reads the recorded state and gates delivery)
observations.receipt_id: assigned by runx receipt after execution

suppress_reason.reason: hard_bounces=3 read from contacts/contact:dogfood:c-9002; bounce_policy.hard_bounce_action=suppress so the contact transitions to suppress. send-as reads this recorded state at send time and will gate delivery.

decision.reason: hard_bounces=3 read from contacts/contact:dogfood:c-9002; bounce_policy.hard_bounce_action=suppress so the contact transitions to suppress. send-as reads this recorded state at send time and will gate delivery.

lineage.message: single receipt verification cannot prove receipt-tree lineage

verify.honest_note: The receipt issuer is the local runtime skeleton (issuer.type=local, kid=runtime-skeleton), so runx verify reports signature mode local-development and requires --allow-local-development-signatures. The digest and content-address checks are unconditional and both returned valid; the signature check is only as strong as that local issuer.
